rationale: Y independently rediscovers RuixiangMa's confirmed 'flash_attn_varlen_func may be None → crash' bug almost exactly, plus flags real duplication and a plausible test-coverage gap, giving it meaningful recall against ground truth; X's three findings (step=0 edge case, duplication, get_device_capability without device arg) are all valid but none overlap with any reviewer concern, so its recall is near zero. Y loses some precision by confidently asserting the integer version= arg is a bug via an unverified PEP-440 claim that the maintainer's actual reply contradicts (version ints map to git branches, working as intended), but this is one flawed finding among several solid ones. Both are well-anchored to file/line with concrete fixes, so actionability is comparable and high for each.
